resolve_current() {
  [[ -L "$TRADING_CURRENT" ]] || {
    printf 'current release link is missing: %s\n' "$TRADING_CURRENT" >&2
    return 1
  }
  CURRENT_RELEASE="$(readlink -f -- "$TRADING_CURRENT")"
  [[ "$CURRENT_RELEASE" == "$TRADING_RELEASES"/* ]] || {
    printf 'current release is outside release root: %s\n' "$CURRENT_RELEASE" >&2
    return 1
  }
  DEPLOYED_SHA="$(basename -- "$CURRENT_RELEASE")"
  [[ "$DEPLOYED_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || {
    printf 'current release directory is not an exact SHA: %s\n' "$DEPLOYED_SHA" >&2
    return 1
  }
  [[ -f "$CURRENT_RELEASE/.disdex-release-sha" ]] || {
    printf 'release marker is missing: %s/.disdex-release-sha\n' "$CURRENT_RELEASE" >&2
    return 1
  }
  MARKER_SHA="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$CURRENT_RELEASE/.disdex-release-sha")"
  [[ "$MARKER_SHA" == "$DEPLOYED_SHA" ]] || {
    printf 'release marker mismatch: directory=%s marker=%s\n' "$DEPLOYED_SHA" "$MARKER_SHA" >&2
    return 1
  }
  [[ -d "$CURRENT_RELEASE/scripts" ]] || {
    printf 'release scripts directory is missing: %s/scripts\n' "$CURRENT_RELEASE" >&2
    return 1
  }
  validate_release_artifacts
  NODE_MODULES_SOURCE_SHA="$(dependency_source_sha "$CURRENT_RELEASE/node_modules")"
  PYTHON_RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA="$(dependency_source_sha "$CURRENT_RELEASE/.venv2")"
}

dependency_source_sha() {
  local dependency_path="$1" resolved target_root target_marker
  if [[ -L "$dependency_path" ]]; then
    resolved="$(readlink -f -- "$dependency_path")"
    target_root="$(dirname -- "$resolved")"
    target="$(basename -- "$target_root")"
    target_marker="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$target_root/.disdex-release-sha")"
    [[ "$target" == "$target_marker" ]] || {
      printf 'dependency source marker mismatch: %s -> %s marker=%s\n' "$dependency_path" "$target_root" "$target_marker" >&2
      return 1
    }
    printf '%s' "$target"
    return 0
  fi
  printf '%s' "$DEPLOYED_SHA"
}
